from fractions import Fraction as F

new = "".join(swap.get(c, c) for c in expr)
toks = new.split()
nums = [F(int(t)) for t in toks[0::2]]; ops = toks[1::2]
# BODMAS: * and / first
vals, pend = [nums[0]], []
for op, n in zip(ops, nums[1:]):
    if op == "*": vals[-1] *= n
    elif op == "/": vals[-1] /= n
    else: pend.append(op); vals.append(n)
result = vals[0]
